menu.title: TITLE
info.controls.title: CONTROLS
info.controls.body: MOVE ARROWS/WASD  FIRE Z  FOCUS CTRL  BOMB X  SYNC C. Hold FIRE with LANCER to lock up to 4 enemies ahead and concentrate option fire. Gamepad is fully supported.
info.scoring.title: SYNC DRIVE SCORING
info.scoring.body: Graze, attack nearby, defeat enemies, and collect green shards to fill 3 SYNC segments. Press SYNC to spend 1-3 full segments. During DRIVE, firepower and score rise and soft bullets cancel. Collect shards above the line to grow the multiplier; it decays when the chain breaks and drops on a hit. Boss bonus rewards time, no miss, no bomb, and banked multiplier.
info.credits.title: CREDITS
info.credits.body: Game design, programming, procedural audio, and original visual direction: Atoyr. Product art generated for this project with OpenAI image generation; no third-party reference image was supplied.
